name: Avy Shin, Blade of Nova Kai
summary: The deck's Unique: it arms the blades, stocks the Retire Zone with Objects and brings them back at every attack.

face.name: Avy Shin, Blade of Nova Kai

rearm.text: Whenever an Entity with an Object assigned you control attacks, you may assign an Object from your Retire Zone to it without paying its Flux cost, if it can receive it.

face.flavor: What the Schism divides, its blade reunites.

effect.text: Other Entities with an Object assigned you control have +1 Power.

foresight.text: The first time each of your turns an Entity with an Object assigned you control attacks, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may reveal an Object among them and put it into your Retire Zone. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck.
